text: You search online for answers, expecting a clear, unbiased overview. You want to understand a complex topic from all angles, getting the full picture.
You click a few links, read articles, then search for related terms. You dive deeper, trusting the system to show you everything relevant.
But soon, something feels off. Your search results look oddly familiar. Less diverse, more of the same information you just consumed.
It's not hiding anything; it's the algorithm learning. The system tracks your clicks and engagement, building a profile of your interests.
It optimizes for engagement, not balance, creating a 'filter bubble.' This echo chamber reinforces what you already clicked or believe.
Next time you search, remember: your digital world is shaped just for you. Challenge it. Actively seek diverse views and burst your bubble.
